learning_outcomes.text: Students with problems related to resource and design can be solved using the principles of the course.
In addition to theoretical and practical knowledge of welding methods, she knows the basic concepts of welding technology
Provides the ability to recognize problems related to welding techniques, propose solutions and develop practical solutions.
Compares welding with other industrial-scale manufacturing methods.

syllabus_topics: Introduction, definition of construction, general principles of welded design
Principles of design appropriate to the stresses, distortions and strains to which welded parts are subjected
Principles of design suitable for manufacturing
Principles of welded design suitable for welding method, welding plan and points to be taken into consideration when making the plan
Principles of welded design with minimum corrosion risk
Display of welding symbols on production drawings
Repair and maintenance welding, welding of stainless steel
